payload.title: Installing the widget command-line tool
payload.body_html:
Installing the widget command-line tool

The tool ships as a single archive. Unpack it into a directory on your path, then run the version command to confirm the installation.

Configuration

Settings live in a plain text file in your home directory. Each line names one option and its value. Restart the tool after editing the file.

payload.title: Installing the command-line client
payload.body_html:
Installing the command-line client

Download the package for your platform and run the installer. On Linux, extract the archive and add the bin directory to your PATH.

Verify the installation by running the client with the --version flag.

payload.title: Configuring logging levels
payload.content:
The logger accepts five levels: debug, info, warning, error and critical. Set the level in the configuration file under the logging section.

Messages below the configured level are discarded.

payload.title: Pagination in list endpoints
payload.body_html:
Pagination in list endpoints

List endpoints return at most one hundred items per page. Pass the cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

An empty cursor means there are no further results.

payload.title: Writing your first plugin

Writing your first plugin

A plugin is a module that exposes a register function. The host calls register once at start-up and passes it a registry object.

payload.content: Raise specific exceptions rather than a bare Exception. Catch only the errors you can handle, and let the rest propagate to the caller.
